name: Sawk (Gi form)
look: a blue karateka in a black gi with a teal collar and lightning-bolt belt tails, a horned black headband, red eyes and a great white-teal mane of jagged electric spikes
entry: A Sawk that has earned the Master's Gi. Its focus is so sharp that it crackles: every chop lands with a thunderclap, and its belt and collar spit sparks as it moves.
how: Use a Master's Gi on a Sawk (it unlocks the Evolve button). It learns Thunder Chop when it changes.
Master's Gi: crafted from six White Wool, a Gold Ingot, a Black Belt and a Diamond, or found in dojo chests.
